verification.validation: Focused portal header unit and DOM tests, real-browser checks of DSM's standalone header (600, 720, 800, 1024 and 1280px; long App and account names, a short name, no account; before/after screenshots, the 1280px short-name and fitting cases byte-identical), the existing portal header and phone shell browser checks, frontend type checking and build, package content scans and generated release metadata checks cover this patch preparation. Executor sources and build inputs are unchanged since the previous SDK release; the immutable executor/v0.49.5 inventory is reused. No publication or NAS acceptance is implied.

changes: At desktop and tablet widths, an App name that would run under the account button in DSM's standalone header ends with an ellipsis 12px before it (DSM 7.3 and 7.4).
With less than an icon's width free the name shows no text beside the App icon; it stays the window's accessible name and its tooltip while cut.
Names that fit, windows without the account button and the mobile layout keep DSM's header unchanged.
Reuse the immutable executor/v0.49.5 release and its six digests.
